invaded.mnemonic: invaded – 'in' + vaad(go): andar ghus ke attack kiya

invention.ex: The telephone was a groundbreaking invention.
invention.mnemonic: invention – naya idea andar aa gaya, nayi cheez bani

impeachment.definition: charging a public official with misconduct
impeachment.ex: The president faced impeachment for abuse of power.
impeachment.mnemonic: impeachment – neta ke pair pakadke court mein khada karna

impurity.definition: quality of being unclean or mixed
impurity.ex: The gold contained traces of impurity.
impurity.mnemonic: PUR = pure; im-purity = jo pure nahi, gandagi

inflammable.ex: Petrol is highly inflammable, so keep it away from fire.
inflammable.mnemonic: inflammable – flame lag jaye, jaldi jal jaata

ingrained.ex: His habits were too ingrained to change easily.
ingrained.mnemonic: ingrained – grain ki tarah andar tak jama aadat

inimical.ex: Pollution is inimical to good health.

inedible.definition: not fit or safe to eat
inedible.ex: The burnt food was completely inedible.
inedible.mnemonic: inedible – 'edible' nahi, khaya nahi ja sakta

insurgent.ex: The insurgents attacked the army base.
insurgent.mnemonic: insurgent – sarkar ke against 'surge' uthaane wala baaghi

ichthyologist.ex: The ichthyologist catalogued a new deep-sea fish.

itinerent.ex: He spelled itinerent wrong in his essay.

inershia.definition: tendency to stay in same state
inershia.ex: His inertia kept him on the bed all morning.

innocense.definition: wrong spelling of innocence, meaning pure
innocense.ex: He wrote innocense instead of innocence in the test.

impracticle.definition: not a real word (impractical is correct)
impracticle.ex: Rahul wrote impracticle instead of impractical.

initiates.ex: The manager initiates the new project today.
initiates.mnemonic: initiates – init means shuruaat, project init karta hai

innumerable.ex: Innumerable stars filled the night sky.
innumerable.mnemonic: innumerable – 'in + number' na ho sake, count hi nahi hota

inadvartant.ex: His inadvertant push made Sita drop her lunch box.

independant.definition: free, not controlled by others (spelling error)
independant.ex: Rahul wants to be independant and earn his own money.

ingenous.ex: 'Ingenous' is not correct; the right word is 'ingenious'.

indict.definition: formally accuse of a serious crime
indict.ex: The grand jury voted to indict the senator.
indict.mnemonic: indict – court mein dictate karke charge lagana

intentionally.mnemonic: intentionally – intention se, jaan-boojh kar kiya

incidentally.definition: by the way; as a side note
incidentally.ex: Incidentally, I met your brother yesterday.
incidentally.mnemonic: incidentally – incident ke saath-saath, waise bhi bata dun

inhabitents.mnemonic: inhabit-ants – ants jaha rehte hai, wahan ke basi

immediately.ex: Call me immediately if there's trouble.
immediately.mnemonic: immediately = beech (med) mein kuch nahi, turant

innoculate.definition: to give a vaccine to protect from disease
innoculate.ex: The doctor came to innoculate children at school.

immigrete.definition: to move to a new country to live
immigrete.ex: Many Indians immigrete to America for jobs.

intermenable.definition: this is a spelling mistake, skip
intermenable.ex: Not a real word, please check spelling.

illicite.definition: wrong spelling of illicit; not legal
illicite.ex: He was punished for his illicite actions at school.

insouciant.ex: He gave an insouciant shrug at the news.
insouciant.mnemonic: insouciant – 'in-so-see-ant', chinta na hone wala bindaas

interogative.definition: A question word like who, what, where
interogative.ex: Who, what, and where are interrogative words Sita uses in class.

illestrious.definition: a misspelling of illustrious; famous person
illestrious.ex: Tagore was an illustrious poet of India.

infurmary.ex: Priya wrote 'infurmary' instead of 'infirmary' in her essay.

insigt.ex: He wrote 'insigt' instead of 'insight' in his essay.

irresistable.definition: so tempting you cannot say no
irresistable.bn: এত মজার যে এড়ানো যায় না
irresistable.ex: The smell of biryani was irresistable to Rahul.

institutions.ex: Banks and schools are important social institutions.
institutions.mnemonic: institution – jo firmly khada kiya gaya sanstha

interrelated.ex: Climate and economy are deeply interrelated issues.
interrelated.mnemonic: inter-related – beech mein sab aapas mein jude hue

irreconcilable.definition: unable to be made compatible or settled
irreconcilable.ex: They had irreconcilable differences and divorced.
irreconcilable.mnemonic: ir-reconcile-able – dono ko phir se milaana naa-mumkin

inflamous.definition: not a real word (often mistaken for infamous)
inflamous.bn: এটি সঠিক শব্দ নয়; প্রায়ই ভুলভাবে ব্যবহৃত
inflamous.ex: The word 'inflamous' is wrongly used instead of 'infamous'.

inadvertant.ex: Sorry, it was an inadvertant mistake in the notebook.

indoulgent.ex: 'Indoulgent' is not the correct spelling, use 'indulgent'.

interupt.definition: Wrong spelling of interrupt, stopping someone talking
interupt.ex: Sita wrote 'interupt' instead of 'interrupt' in her English exam.

infnite.ex: The teacher told Prija that 'infnite' is a wrong spelling.

irascible.ex: The irascible old man shouted at everyone.
irascible.mnemonic: irascible – 'ira' matlab gussa, jhat se bhadak jaye
